high.evidence: Normal publication omits top-level verdict while terminal_manifest_valid requires it, so every completed probe converts to failure recovery.
high.acceptance_test: Bind manifest verdict to summary verdict and test complete PASS and FAIL publication with intended exit codes.

high.evidence: A valid manifest containing only raw/summary is trusted despite omitted arm artifacts, and signals are unblocked between parse return and row/binding publication.
high.acceptance_test: Require exact complete regular-file inventory, schema/component fields, summary verdict, completed_rows/raw count, and block termination across parse plus row/binding publication.

high.evidence: Same missing-verdict defect; validation must also parse summary, match verdict and completed_rows to raw rows, and enforce schema requirements.
high.acceptance_test: Factor/test normal PASS and FAIL publication; missing/mismatched verdict and row count fail.

high.evidence: Store/hit use suffix-anchored search and ON uses endswith, so malformed arbitrary prefixes on the sole expected event pass.
high.acceptance_test: Normalize only the exact logger timestamp prefix and fullmatch the entire event payload; prefix, suffix, concatenation, number, and extra mutations fail.

medium.evidence: Failure finalization calls artifact collection without the completed arms' expected bindings, so replacement plus interruption can silently bless replacement bytes in a FAIL archive.
medium.acceptance_test: Keep active authoritative bindings and make replacement-plus-interruption fail identity validation while preserving expected and observed evidence.
